basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has notified 2 project-based vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post. The engagement is initially for 1 year and shall be extended based on performance. The pay for the Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37000 for 1st two years, Rs. 42000 from 3rd year - 5th year with applicable HRA. Eligible candidates possessing ME/M.Tech (RF and Microwave Engineering / Communication Systems / Signal Processing or equivalent) / M.Sc. (Electronics) with GATE/NET can apply by email. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces a total of 02 project positions for Junior Research Fellow under the specified research project in the Dept. of Electronics and Communication Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational qualifications and national eligibility tests to be considered for the position. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. The selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission.

rows.essential_qualification: ME/M.Tech. (RF and Microwave Engineering / Communication Systems / Signal Processing or equivalent) / M.Sc. (Electronics). Candidates should have qualified GATE/NET.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments for the Junior Research Fellow are Rs. 37000 for 1st two years, Rs. 42000 from 3rd year - 5th year with applicable HRA. The position is initially for 1 year and shall be extended based on performance.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be assigned the following core duty under the project: To conduct research on the above-mentioned topic.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Candidates before appearing for the interview (to be held in ONLINE mode) shall ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply. Candidates desiring to appear for the Interview should submit their applications with the following documents to the office of Principal Investigator through email ( [email protected] ): Application in a plain paper with detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree certificates obtained. Experience including research, industrial field and others. Attested copies of degree certificate and experience certificate. Proof of GATE/NET. Ensure the application is submitted to the office of Principal Investigator by 5 November 2026 by 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates desiring to appear for the interview should submit their applications with the required documents to the office of the Principal Investigator through email. Only shortlisted candidates shall be called for the interview. The interview will be held in ONLINE mode.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 02 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the application to be submitted to office of Principal Investigator is 5 November 2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess ME/M.Tech. (RF and Microwave Engineering / Communication Systems / Signal Processing or equivalent) / M.Sc. (Electronics). Candidates should have qualified GATE/NET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37000 for 1st two years, Rs. 42000 from 3rd year - 5th year with applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their application on plain paper with detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree certificates obtained, experience including research, industrial field and others, attested copies of degree certificate and experience certificate, and proof of GATE/NET via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Will all applicants be called for the interview?
faq.answer: No, only shortlisted candidates shall be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any preference given to specific categories?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Can selected candidates pursue a PhD?
faq.answer: The selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission.
